vvb_guidance.verbatim_pp_documentation: Previously reported - summary only. June, August, September, November, and December 2025 were documented in full and verified in earlier Reporting Periods. The earlier Periods (June, August, and September 2025) correspond to the aqueous-fraction (QOWV) oil injected this period, and November-December 2025 correspond to the oil-fraction (WODO) oil. To avoid duplication, only the Production Period Summary is included here for reference; the complete supporting documentation for these Periods resides in the corresponding prior Reporting Period packages.
vvb_guidance.verbatim_new_this_rp: New this Reporting Period - full documentation package. January 2026, March 2026, and April 2026 are reported for the first time in this Reporting Period, and the complete supporting package is included for each
vvb_guidance.verbatim_ibc_tote_return: In this Reporting Period, Charm began returning emptied intermediate bulk container (IBC) totes from the Basco injection site in Louisiana back to its production facility in Fort Lupton, Colorado.
vvb_guidance.note: No section in the July RP guidance addresses QOWV transport emission-factor selection, QOWV tote residual mass, or LCS. The Trailer Standard Empty Weight section applies only to AECN rail offloads and names only Week 1 AECN offloads.

pdd_supplemental.verbatim_ef_vehicle_type: Transport process emissions are computed using the "Distance-Based Method" outlined in Section 3.3 of the Transportation Emissions Accounting Module. For a given journey, the mass of cargo is multiplied by the journey distance and the product is multiplied by a Well-to-Wheel emission factor for the appropriate vehicle type used for the journey.
pdd_supplemental.verbatim_distance_rule: Distance: The route between origin and destination will be set using Google maps, selecting the longest route if multiple are presented
pdd_supplemental.verbatim_charm_tote_mass: Mass: Charm bio-oil is currently transported in totes -- Once filled, totes are weighted on a calibrated scale and the weight is recorded along with a corresponding UID number. Oil mass is estimated as the gross weight of the tote less its tare weight
pdd_supplemental.verbatim_ef_source: Distance-based emission factors from GLEC V3 Section 3 Module 2 will be used unless otherwise noted
